description: The regulator publishes gas and hydrogen network-development plans, scenario documents, implementation status and proposed expansion tables. The page distinguishes draft submissions, consultations and approved scenario assumptions. The provider is Bundesnetzagentur and regulated network operators. Coverage: Coverage is Germany, with the 2025 plan addressing 2037 and 2045. The reviewed page identifies a second draft submitted in June 2026 and linked Excel and PDF annexes. Access: The official page links the plans and annexes publicly. Files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Draft proposals and consultation material do not establish approved or built infrastructure. Different documents have distinct approval dates and must be labelled accordingly. For simulation it supplies official planning scenarios and proposed infrastructure changes. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
